title: Nested groups
text: Links and expandable groups in any depth, with the active item and its groups marked.

title: Icon rail
text: Collapses to an icon rail with the labels shown as tooltips.

title: Drawer on small screens
text: Below a breakpoint it becomes an off-canvas drawer with focus moved in and restored.

title: Cancelable navigation
text: Navigate events can be canceled for client-side routing or unsaved-change checks.
